tacz_pip_scope.config.surfaceTextureType: 0: Original, 1: Fine wear, 2: Wiping marks (default), 3: Smudges. Only active in image mode. Dirt and scratches share this image.
tacz_pip_scope.config.edgeRefraction.too: Bend the image in a narrow peripheral band, preserving the aiming center.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensGhost.tooltip: Approximate small light ghosts in bright scenes.
tacz_pip_scope.config.gunFocusBlur.toolt: Soften the nearby gun layer, not the reticle. Adds rendering cost.
tacz_pip_scope.config.idleGlass.tooltip: Add a faint highlight to idle optical lenses without showing a magnified image.
tacz_pip_scope.config.surfaceTexture: Use an image for scratches and dirt
tacz_pip_scope.config.surfaceTexture.too: ON: image mode. OFF: procedural mode, not effects disabled. Use each effect's switch to disable scratches or dirt.
tacz_pip_scope.config.enableWorldFovProt: Keep the background unzoomed. Enable when using PiP.
tacz_pip_scope.config.enableLensComposit: Display a magnified view inside the lens.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lockOpticalModelVi: Prevent the gun moving closer when changing magnification.
tacz_pip_scope.config.showGunInsidePipLe: Display the gun body through the scope.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensEffects.toolti: Master switch for distortion, color separation, vignette and mask feathering.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensDistortion.too: Distort the image near the lens edge.
tacz_pip_scope.config.distortionStrength: Default: 0.08. High values fold the image.
tacz_pip_scope.config.chromaticAberratio: Add subtle color separation at the lens edge.
tacz_pip_scope.config.eyeboxEffect.toolt: Soften the aperture-shaped black mask during aiming transitions.
tacz_pip_scope.config.maskEdgeSoftness.t: Default: 0.1. Higher values widen the feather. Zero disables it.
tacz_pip_scope.config.surfacePattern.too: 0–9999, default 6. Rotates/shifts the shared image or changes procedural placement. The same number reproduces the pattern. Does not select a different image.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensDirt.tooltip: Add subtle peripheral smudges while protecting the aiming center.
tacz_pip_scope.config.dirtStrength.toolt: 0–1, default 0.12. Controls darkening from dirt, not scratch opacity or pattern. Zero disables dirt.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensScratches.tool: Add fine scratches visible against bright backgrounds, without affecting the reticle.
tacz_pip_scope.config.scratchDensity.too: Procedural mode only. 0–4x count, default 4. Zero disables procedural scratches. Ignored in image mode, including zero. Use scratch opacity for image visibility.
tacz_pip_scope.config.scratchSize.toolti: 0–4x, default 1.4. Scales the whole scratch image (edges may be cropped), or procedural line length/width. Does not scale dirt. Zero disables scratches.
tacz_pip_scope.config.scratchStrength.to: 0–1, default 0.6. Controls visibility, not count or placement. Zero disables scratches. More visible against bright backgrounds.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensReflection.too: Soft eye-dependent reflected light, not a mirrored scene.
tacz_pip_scope.config.peripheralBlur.too: Soften the outer image, preserving the aiming center and reticle. Adds sampling cost.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensCoating.toolti: Add a faint colored reflection. Approximation, not a reflected scene.
tacz_pip_scope.config.lensHaze.tooltip: Add a thin light veil in bright scenes.
tacz_pip_scope.config.performance.toolti: Applies only to the scope view, not the main view.
tacz_pip_scope.config.pipResolution.tool: 25–100%. Default: 75%. Lower values reduce detail and pixel workload.
tacz_pip_scope.config.pipMaxFps.tooltip: 0: unlimited. 1–240: limit world image updates. Low values cause visible lag when turning.
tacz_pip_scope.config.pipEntities.toolti: Disabling hides players, enemies, animals and dropped items inside the scope.
tacz_pip_scope.config.pipBlockEntities.t: Show chests and other block entities in the scope. Disabling hides some or all of their model.
tacz_pip_scope.config.pipParticles.toolt: Show scope-world particles. Weather and custom gun effects may use separate renderers.
